surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves sequential, self-limiting surface reactions where Pt is deposited on the inner surfaces of carbon aerogels. The process uses (methylcyclopentadienyl)-trimethylplatinum (MeCpPtMe3) and oxygen (dry air) as precursors. The reaction mechanism includes the adsorption of MeCpPtMe3 followed by a water pulse to regenerate OH sites, leading to the formation of Pt nanoparticles on the surface.
